response_protocol: Official DSH native tools; no DH JSON wire or orthogonality gates

grading_resources.note: Independent grading needs enough compile capacity to honor unchanged official test timeouts; both arms use identical settings.

known_upstream_defects.detail: Unmodified official P2P requests READMD.md, absent from the pinned starter; 18/19 pass before solving. Keep raw official scores; do not attribute this pre-existing failure to a solver.

budget_definition: 800 total provider streams/attempts, including title, compaction, retries and subagents; 600 model-root native tool dispatches; 7200 seconds
pilot_policy: First task is included; no paid retry or automatic failed-task replay
comparison_limits: DSH native context management differs from DH
Native tool types differ: report shell, file, and bookkeeping counts separately
preserved_shared_state: read-only runtime and immutable input images only
context_comparison_note: DSH uses the official model 1M context capacity, NOT a matched 16K window. Historical DH uses 48000 characters. This is a practical comparison, NOT an equal-context single-factor ablation.
retry_comparison_note: DSH hard 800 ceiling includes retries; historical DH 800 logical requests allowed separately counted wire retries
execution_comparison_note: DSH solves in new academy Docker containers; historical DH solved in CubeStudio private chroots from the same pinned toolchain exports. This is a historical practical comparison, not a single-factor ablation.
